name: Perceptually Linear Transfer Function
aliases: Perceptually Linear Transfer Function for Direct Volume Rendering
definition: A method to map volume density values to transfer function inputs such that the resulting rendered intensities are linear in Just Noticeable Difference (JND) space, optimizing the use of HDR display contrast for human perception.
summary: The Perceptually Linear Transfer Function maps volume densities to JND space, ensuring equal transfer function steps produce equal perceptual intensity changes for optimized HDR display contrast.
